npcRoster.name: Archivist Thiblee Jannar
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Archivist Thiblee Jannar is a brilliant, anxious Tiefling lore-proctor with a talent for arcane systems, construct interfaces, archive wards, and accidentally activating exactly the wrong failsafe at the worst possible time. He/them is socially awkward, over-eager, and sometimes oblivious to how dangerous his curiosity can become, but his intelligence is real, especially when repairing sentient machinery, decoding relic protocols, or building safer ways to catalogue ichor-tainted artifacts.
At the Kael'vyrûn Market Hall, Thiblee works for the Crucible Wardens maintaining relic inventories, automated archive assistants, restricted research ledgers, and containment records for ichor-powered devices. He is deeply devoted to his spouse, Scribe Paelyn Jannar, who helps keep him grounded when ambition, insecurity, or a very tempting glowing button threatens to turn “one quick upgrade” into a citywide emergency.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Kael'vyrûn is a City in Kaelvorrin, under Consensus Democracy, with moderate danger, Farming, Partial forest, Marshes and swamps terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Ferry, Skyship. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Tiefling reads through the Tiefling entry of the race compendium, within Celestial, Fiendish, and Planar Bloodlines, marked by Freyseth. Tieflings are fiend-touched humanoids marked by infernal ancestry and social stigma. They often develop strong individuality and resilience in the face of prejudice. Table cues: Darkvision, Fiendish Legacy, Otherworldly Presence; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Neutral - Neutral.
publicRumors: Archivist Thiblee Jannar knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Archivist Thiblee Jannar has a contact in Aelthéon who will deny everything.

npcRoster.name: Rufin Rubens
npcRoster.publicDescription: Rufin Rubens is a Dwarf repairman with nimble hands, tavern gossip, and a talent for finding uses for machines everyone else left rusting in basements. He fixes locks, boilers, drink lines, lift gears, caravan carts, and temperamental constructs for the Brass Concordat, usually while pretending the job is easier than it is. Rufin is practical and friendly, but when old machines are tied to ichor, alcohol, or missing people, he starts asking questions no one hired him to ask.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.

provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Kaelvorrin is centered at 6.383293, 5.827743 under Consensus Democracy, with 133,180,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Kaelvorrin occupies 5,610,032.72 sq mi / 14,529,918.04 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.848636% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Grassland define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming and Partial forest. Population density is 9.166 people/sq km / 23.740 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
